items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The lead alto player was Marshall Royal. I mentioned Thad Jones, didn’t I?

ctx.x: Frank Wess and Frank Foster. Boy, what a band that was. The lead alto player was Marshall Royal. I mentioned Thad Jones, didn’t I?

items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Ray Brown played bass, Ross Tomkins (PHONETIC) was piano player, and Louie Bellson was the drummer. So, it would probably be Snookie Young, Marshal Royal or Marshal Royal, Snookie Young or something.

ctx.x: And it was during that period, too, that -- when you were (inaudible)?
He'd made a trip. Louie Bellson made a trip with us over there, but that was a thing like four, five, six weeks or something. He was never a regular in the Basie band. He worked there for a trip.
